mapper.select: select distinct p.parent_id, p.code, p.name, p.type, p.path, p.icon, p.status, p.sort_order from sys_role_permission rp inner join sys_permission p on rp.permission_id = p.id where rp.role_id in (select r.id from sys_user_role ur inner join sys_role r on r.id=ur.role_id where ur.user_id=#{userId} and r.status='ACTIVE') and p.status='ACTIVE' order by p.sort_order, p.id;
